items.note: The prompt doesn't frame the choice as staying on pgvector versus moving to a dedicated vector database.
There is no data scale: not the 5M embeddings, the 1536 dimensions, or the growth of 1M per quarter.
It doesn't say the team already runs Postgres 16 on AWS RDS.
The budget limit of under $500 per month is absent.
The need to filter queries by tenant_id for multi-tenancy isn't mentioned.
There is no cap of at most 4 options.
It doesn't ask for a comparison table plus one recommendation.
It gives no preference for sources from the last 12 months.
The approach of a wide scan first, then a deep look at the top 2, isn't specified.
